# Affinova

> Affinova is a product discovery and buying-guide website featuring curated products, comparisons, deals and affiliate links.

## Main sections
- Homepage: https://affinova.cyou/
- Products: https://affinova.cyou/#products
- Categories: https://affinova.cyou/#categories
- Deals: https://affinova.cyou/#deals
- Guides: https://affinova.cyou/#guides
- About: https://affinova.cyou/about
- Affiliate disclosure: https://affinova.cyou/affiliate-disclosure
- Privacy: https://affinova.cyou/privacy
- Contact: https://affinova.cyou/contact

## Discovery
- Sitemap: https://affinova.cyou/sitemap.xml
- AI catalog: https://affinova.cyou/ai-catalog.json

## Usage notes
Product prices, availability and offers may change. Affiliate links may earn Affinova a commission at no extra cost to the buyer. Use the canonical product and guide URLs published by Affinova when referencing site content.
